meta.name: senpi-qa
meta.description: QA the omo Senpi adapter (packages/omo-senpi, packages/senpi-task) against the REAL senpi binary in strict isolation, and write every artifact to the one canonical evidence path .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/. The live drivers under packages/omo-senpi/scripts/qa/ create their own isolated SENPI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and ignore the caller's, so the real ~/.senpi/agent is never written. Ships scripts/resolve-evidence-dir.mjs, which is the ONLY sanctioned way to pick an evidence directory: it rejects traversal, separators, absolute paths, and stray roots such as local-ignore/qa-evidence. Use whenever someone changes anything under packages/omo-senpi or packages/senpi-task, or wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug the Senpi adapter, the task/team engine, the DAG, task RPC, or skill delivery. Triggers: senpi qa, qa senpi, senpi-qa, test senpi adapter, verify senpi task, senpi task e2e, senpi team e2e, task dag qa, live senpi driver, senpi evidence path.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 测试 Senpi 适配器隔离运行，确保不污染真实环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果改动过 Senpi 适配器代码，想要隔离验证却不想碰真实数据。
copy.tagline_en: Test the Senpi adapter in isolation without touching your real environment.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you changed the Senpi adapter and need isolated QA without touching real data.

howto.what: 被要求对 Senpi 适配器/任务引擎做 QA 时,Claude 使用真实 senpi 程序,在隔离目录中运行,不影响本机 senpi 数据;产物统一写入 .omo/evidence 下的证据目录并附说明;找不到 senpi 就标 SKIP/FAIL。
howto.when: 当你改动 packages/omo-senpi 或 packages/senpi-task 下代码,或要求对 Senpi 适配器/任务引擎做 QA、验证、调试时触发(如“senpi qa”“verify senpi task”)。

say.text: 帮我跑 task-e2e,验证 Senpi 任务从启动到结束是否正常。
say.note: 运行结果写入规定证据目录,并生成说明。

say.text: 先检查 senpi 二进制是否可用,不可用就标 SKIP。
say.note: 说明里会记 SKIP/FAIL;SKIP 不算通过。

howto.what_en: When asked to QA the Senpi adapter, Claude drives the real senpi binary in an isolated dir, never touches ~/.senpi/agent, writes artifacts/README under .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/, and reports SKIP/FAIL if senpi is absent.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you change code under packages/omo-senpi or packages/senpi-task, or ask to QA/verify/debug the Senpi adapter or task engine (e.g. “senpi qa”, “verify senpi task”).

say_en.text: I just changed packages/omo-senpi; please run a live QA on the Senpi adapter.
say_en.note: Uses an isolated dir and the canonical evidence path.

say_en.text: Run task-e2e to verify a Senpi task from start to finish.
say_en.note: Writes task states to the canonical evidence path.

say_en.text: If the senpi binary is missing, mark SKIP instead of passing.
say_en.note: README records SKIP/FAIL; SKIP is not a pass.
